issues.message: F19 combines two different actions and goals, advancing fulfilment and cancelling with stock restore, in one flow. Fix: Split F19 into two act flows on Order: one to advance fulfilment from New to Packed then to Shipped or Picked Up, and one to cancel a New or Packed Order with stock restored, each with a single goal and outcome.
Order reference is stored on the Order and used to look it up, but its noun is empty. Fix: Set FD17 "noun" to "Order" so the reference is kept by the Order record it identifies.
